script: The saber-toothed cat Smilodon was not a tiger. Its fangs could be about 28 centimeters long, including the root. It could open its jaws about 120 degrees, far wider than a lion. It lived in the Americas until about 10,000 years ago. Thousands of Smilodon fossils have been pulled from the La Brea Tar Pits in Los Angeles. It was not a dinosaur; it lived long after them, in the Ice Age. Follow DinoBytes for more prehistoric facts.
